bio: Enjoy a quintessential English treat, and indulge your sweet tooth with Fowey Hall's traditional Afternoon Tea.  With their passion for food, the traditional Afternoon Tea has been lovingly crafted with a classic selection of finger sandwiches, homemade scones with preserve and clotted cream, alongside a selection of cakes and sweet treats. Your Afternoon Tea is served with Higgins loose-leaf tea or coffee.  Children's Afternoon Tea is also available priced from £15 per child, which features a selection of treats and is served alongside activity sheets for children to enjoy during service, or to continue the experience at home.  Fowey Hall sits in a spectacular location overlooking the sailing and fishing port of Fowey on the South Cornish coast, within its original walled gardens and with commanding views of the river estuary and far out to sea.
